title: Inspectable signal cursor
scenario: I19 · exact and pointer previews, cancel, commit, undo, replay and conflict
host: macOS · T3 collaborative preview incognito · Electron 44.10.1 / Chromium 152.0.7977.169
backend: Moxi Python reference SVG + DOM pointer/keyboard events
fixture: 101 synthetic signal samples, cursor starts at 25
reproduce: From the repository root follow experiments/inspectable-interactions/README.md at 1100 × 1050 CSS pixels and scale 2. Apply the slide actions in order.

slides.caption: Numeric preview
slides.expected: The orange cursor follows sample 70 while origin and revision stay at 25 and 0.

slides.caption: Escape restores the origin
slides.expected: The field and marker return to 25. Undo depth stays at 0.

slides.caption: Pointer preview
slides.action: Drag the orange cursor to the horizontal center of the SVG and release.
slides.expected: The inspector shows preview 47, origin 25. Commit move is available.

slides.caption: One committed move
slides.expected: The command records revision 0 and move 25 to 47. Undo depth increases to 1.

slides.caption: Single undo
slides.expected: The marker returns to 25 at revision 2, undo depth 0. The recording remains available.

slides.caption: Changed layout
slides.expected: The independent baseline copy starts at 25 and revision 0 in a plot two thirds as wide.

slides.caption: Semantic replay
slides.expected: Sample 47 on the narrower trace becomes the committed cursor at revision 1.

slides.caption: Stale target
slides.expected: A stale-target message appears. Sample 47, revision 1 and undo depth 1 are preserved.

slides.caption: Out-of-range numeric entry
slides.expected: The active constraint is explained. Commit is disabled and the marker stays at 47.
